title: 💻 Multiple IT Openings in Maury County, TN - Up to $61K+ - NewsBreak
text:
1 days ago Maury County’s tech scene is growing fast, with new roles for both hands-on support pros and data experts. If you’re looking to stay local and level up your IT career, these openings are worth a look.
Data Modeler (W2 Hiring – ER/Studio, Snowflake) Employer: Jobs via Dice (for Collaborate Solutions, Inc.)
Location: Columbia, TN
Type: Full-time
Design and build data models that keep business systems running smoothly. You’ll work with tools like ER/Studio, Snowflake, and Databricks to ensure data integrity and performance. Great fit for someone who loves structure and collaboration.
Desktop Support Technician Employer: Columbia State Community College
Location: Columbia, TN (travel to other campuses)
Type: Full-time
Salary: $51,530–$61,830
Support computers, printers, and software across multiple campuses. This role offers steady hours, strong benefits, and the chance to help keep classrooms and offices running. Ideal for someone with CompTIA A+ or similar certifications who enjoys solving tech problems on the go.
